summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier) and SHACLPathError(Exception), following the seven-step workflow. Added test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with a module-scoped Turtle fixture, parametrized valid and invalid cases for each error branch, a non-node input test, and a graph-unchanged check. Ran tests with the shared venv: the new tests and test/test_path.py pass (42 passed). Not verified: mypy (warn_unused_ignores placement), black, and isort, since none is installed in the shared venv and I was not allowed to install packages. Design choices: a non-Node guard runs before the triple lookups so that None is not treated as a wildcard; arg-type ignores sit on parser calls that receive optional lookup results; operator ignores are on bare-IRI modifier lines only. Nothing committed; no existing files changed.
